org.description: ONDE (onde.tn) is a Tunisian startup selling NFC stands, cards, keychains and stickers that collect Google reviews in one tap. Delivered anywhere in Tunisia, cash on delivery.

shop.kicker: Shop · Google review stands, NFC cards and stickers

faq.q: How much is an NFC Google review stand at ONDE?
faq.a: The Google review stand (NFC + QR code, 12 × 12 cm) is {stand}, the NFC card {card}, the NFC keychain {keychain} and the NFC sticker {sticker}. Prices are in Tunisian dinars and paid on delivery; delivery costs {fee} and is free from {threshold}.

faq.q: Is there a subscription or a monthly fee?
faq.a: No. The ONDE smart link is included in the price of the product, with no subscription: you pay once. Changing where the link leads is part of that included service.

faq.q: Stand, sticker, card or keychain: which one should I choose?
faq.a: The stand sits on the counter or by the till, where every customer passes. Stickers make tables, menus and shop windows tappable. The NFC card goes with your waiters or sales reps, the keychain with people on the move. For a café or restaurant, the Café Pack combines 2 stands and 4 stickers.

faq.q: Do I have to program the NFC chip myself?
faq.a: No. These aren't blank tags: every product arrives configured with your ONDE link and tested before shipping. Put it down, your customers tap.

faq.q: What if my customer's phone has no NFC?
faq.a: The stands also carry a printed QR code that leads to the same link: any smartphone camera can scan it.

faq.q: Do I need my Google review link to order?
faq.a: No, it's optional. You can paste it when you order; otherwise we find it with you during the confirmation call.

faq.q: Can I equip several counters, venues or a whole team?
faq.a: Yes. Every product carries its own link: one per venue, per counter or per team member. The Team Pack bundles 5 NFC cards; for a larger order, message us on WhatsApp.
